note: A null test is a pass whose arms record-treatment found identical in content, so its speedup is a measurement of nothing. Counted only where one pass wrote both results/treatment.json and results/summary.json, since before record-treatment carried always_run a commit could pair a stale treatment record with a real measurement; skipped_unpaired counts the commits rejected on that test, which includes the harmless case of a later commit re-committing an already counted pass. earlier_abs_max_pct covers the passes run on shorter windows and coarser timesteps than the current benchmark, whose noise is not interchangeable with this one's -- n_current_window says how many nulls exist at the window in use now, and current_window_mean_pct is the floor to subtract from a headline measured there. current_window_all_same_sign distinguishes a jitter straddling zero from a confound that repeats, which averaging does not reduce.
